_duckdns.title: DuckDNS
_duckdns.desc: Dynamic DNS via DuckDNS. Your public IP is announced to DuckDNS every 5 minutes.
_duckdns.label: DuckDNS Update URL
_duckdns.help: Enter the full DuckDNS update URL. Format: https://www.duckdns.org/update?domains={domain}&token={token}&ip= Replace {domain} with your DuckDNS domain name and {token} with the token from your DuckDNS account.
_duckdns.confirm_clear: Are you sure you want to remove the DuckDNS configuration?
_duckdns.saved: Configuration saved. The new URL is used from the next update cycle.
_duckdns.invalid_url: The URL must start with https://www.duckdns.org/update?domains=
_duckdns.unreplaced_placeholders: Please replace {domain} and {token} with your actual values.
